facts.business: Fujiyama Power Systems Limited operates in the Indian rooftop solar industry, manufacturing and supplying solar panels, inverters, and batteries under the UTL Solar and Fujiyama Solar brands.
key_risks: Fire incident at Bawal production facility causing damage to building structures, machinery, and inventory worth Rs 1,576.30 million
BIS inspections and seizure of products worth Rs 24.50 million at Greater Noida facility and Rs 19 million at Bawal facility for alleged non-compliance with BIS standards
